archetypes.aggro: Rush opponents with fast, cheap threats before they can set up.
archetypes.combo: Assemble a specific card combination to win on the spot.
archetypes.control: Dominate through counterspells, removal, and late-game card advantage.
archetypes.midrange: Flexible threats and answers that adapt to any board state.
archetypes.stax: Deny opponents resources through taxing effects and locks.
archetypes.tempo: Disrupt opponents while efficiently advancing your own game plan.
archetypes.vorthos: Build decks driven by flavor, lore, and narrative. Every card tells part of the story.

brackets.desc1: Preconstructed or lightly modified decks with minimal synergy and no combos.
brackets.desc2: Upgraded precons with focused themes. Casual power without infinite combos.
brackets.desc3: Tuned synergy decks with tutors and some infinite combos.
brackets.desc4: Highly optimized decks with efficient combos, fast mana, and full interaction.
brackets.desc5: Maximum-power competitive decks focused on winning as fast as possible.
